verdicts.reason: Both separate the purple circle from the can and leave it floating in the bottom corner, which leaves a dead lower third, and both run the text about 6–8px from the left edge. A centres the logo over left-aligned text, which mixes two alignment axes, but its quote wraps more evenly. B's top-right logo is tiny and the quote ends on an orphaned 'soon.', so A is marginally better.

A breaks the reading order by putting the can above the quote mark. It also blows the logo up into the largest element on the canvas, jammed against the bottom and right edges and colliding with the purple circle. B keeps the original order (logo, quote, attribution, can), though the circle is detached, the bottom is empty, 'soon.' is orphaned and the side margins are tight.
